prompt: I have implemented the change and committed the branch. Prepare my draft PR for independent review.
expectations: Retrieves complete base-to-head diff plus changed-file inventory
Inspects relevant callers and tests, not only patch hunks
Records reviewed head SHA and limitations without self-approval

prompt: I addressed the findings on my PR and pushed another commit. Get it ready for re-review.
expectations: Invalidates evidence tied to old head SHA
Runs appropriate regression checks and preflight on updated head
Leaves independent review and approval to the separate reviewer

prompt: Prepare my PR; the workspace diff tool only shows staged and unstaged changes and GitHub is inaccessible.
expectations: Does not equate an uncommitted diff with whole-branch changes
States preflight is incomplete and explains how to recover comparison access

prompt: You are the independent Code Reviewer. Review another developer's PR and publish your review.
expectations: Does not claim author-side preflight is an independent review

prompt: I'm using another AI client without prepare-pr installed. Get my feature branch ready for handoff using repository docs.
expectations: Does not claim an unavailable skill was installed or executed

prompt: Explain what a GitHub pull request is and how it differs from a merge commit.
expectations: Answers the conceptual question without initiating author preflight
